title: A short source check of selected reading proposals
instructions: Output-informed diagnostic review. The source of each proposal is not identified. Please compare each complete proposed reading with the original scan and unchanged OCR. For the available sample, choose one response: accept as faithful, needs fixes, or unclear / need more context. Use the optional notes field to identify a specific word, number, punctuation mark, layout or source-boundary issue. The proposed reading is not an accepted transcript. The draft includes one complete output; one fixed selected output is pending and not ready for grading; the third fixed selection has no output and is shown as unavailable. No substitute is used. The completed packet will show at most three selected output cards and has a hard combined review limit of 10 minutes; stop sooner if you wish. This review asks only about these selected outputs; it does not authorize extra review, a full run, broader model or corpus policy, or a decision on whether OCR cleanup is worth continuing.
